From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>

Subject: Boreal Tech — cost recap & request for formal quote

Alex — thanks again for the demo and walkthrough earlier today. Quick recap and the numbers we discussed so your procurement team has a single source of truth. Attaching a granular estimate and the CSV pricing calculator used to arrive at these figures.

High-level summary (monthly run-rate targets you gave):
- Expected inference volume: 40M tokens/day (peak 60M), roughly 1.2B tokens/month nominal.
- Target unit economics: $700–$1,000 per 1M tokens (you mentioned $900 as internal target)
- Initial contract term: 12 months with quarterly performance reviews

Redwood estimate (starting config):
- Model: rdx-m4-8b-quant (optimized quant profile)
- Avg latency SLO: 120–160ms p95 (production routing across us-west/us-east)
- Effective blended unit price: $825 / 1M tokens (this reflects batching, prefix caching, and a modest quantization uplift)
- Estimated monthly cost at 1.2B tokens: ~$990,000 (range $840k–$1.2M depending on hit rates and burst)

Line items and assumptions are in the attached spreadsheet. Notable callouts:
- We applied standard committed-capacity discounts at the 1.2B token tier.
- We assumed 25% prefix/KV cache hit rate (you indicated heavy repetition in system prompts). If cache hit is >40% we can reduce to ~$740 / 1M tokens.
- Startup discount (one-time) is available for new customers in first 3 months — see Marissa's note below on how that changes the quote.

Next steps I propose:
1) Can procurement confirm the desired contract term and billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly)?
2) If you want a formal, signable quote/PO ready for legal, say so and I’ll generate a DocuSign-ready quote by tomorrow (I’ve included a placeholder DocuSign link in related links).
3) Marissa (cc) will drop a short note with the discount mechanics and one-line technical assumptions to include in the SLA.

Attachments: Boreal_Redwood_Estimate_20260405.xlsx (detailed cost model), boreal_pricing_calculator_20260405.csv

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Alex — quick note from solutions on two items you asked about that affect the formal quote:

1) Implementation/onboarding: we typically charge a one-time setup fee that covers private VPC routing, model onboarding, and integration validation. For your scale and required launch timeline, estimate = $45k (can be amortized across first 3 invoices). If you prefer we can include a line item for SOW-based professional services instead.

2) Lead time for dedicated capacity: with a 12-month commitment and our current capacity plan, dedicated pool provisioning in us-west takes ~3–4 weeks. If you need cross-region redundancy (us-east), add ~1 week. We can prioritize Boreal on the provisioning queue if a signed commitment is in place.

Discount mechanics: we can stack the startup one-time discount (up to 15% for first 3 months) with a tiered volume rebate that kicks in at >=1B tokens/month. That rebate would be applied retroactively on monthly usage. Exact rebate schedule is in the attached spreadsheet (tab: rebates).

I'll prepare a short technical appendix to include in the quote describing the caching/latency assumptions — Vivek, ping me if you want me to keep it under one page for procurement.

—Marissa
